Name: BBBoong's Ridgeside Village Seasonal Outfits
Author: 1oOwOo1
Description:
This is BBBoong's Ridgeside Village Seasonal Outfits, containing all villagers.
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/hshdehhdhdj/about-me?gameId=1303]hshdehhdhdj[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz/about-me?gameId=1303&_gl=1*11fzhz6*_ga*NTAyNzkwMTk0LjE3MDIyODA3NTM.*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTcxNTE0MDA2Mi4yODkuMS4xNzE1MTQ0NTc4LjAuMC4w]Rafseazz[/url]﻿. Without their help, I would not be able to successfully upload this mod.

[b][color=#ffff00]Attention: [/color][/b][color=#ffff00]In order to adapt to the version and personal preferences, I have made modifications to some of the portraits. So when installing this mod, it is necessary to replace[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286] Ridgeside Village[/url][color=#ffff00] and[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202?tab=description] Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village[/url][color=#ffff00].

[/color][b]How to install:
[/b]1.Install[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286] Ridgeside Village[/url] and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202?tab=description] Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village[/url]
2.Dowload and unzip my mod
3.Drag and drop Ridgeside Village to \steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\Ridgeside Village
4.Drag and drop [CP] RSV Seasonal Outfits to \steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\[CP] RSV Seasonal Outfits

这是BBBoong风格的里奇赛德村季节性服装，目前包含所有角色。
感谢[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/hshdehhdhdj/about-me?gameId=1303]hshdehhdhdj[/url]﻿和[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz/about-me?gameId=1303&_gl=1*11fzhz6*_ga*NTAyNzkwMTk0LjE3MDIyODA3NTM.*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTcxNTE0MDA2Mi4yODkuMS4xNzE1MTQ0NTc4LjAuMC4w]Rafseazz[/url]﻿，没有他们的帮助，我无法顺利发布模组。

[b]安装方法：

2.下载我的mod
3.用我的mod分别对[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286] Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ 和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202?tab=description] Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village[/url] 进行替换
